import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check the dist file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -5 /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/modules/npc/NPCRelationshipSystem.js")
print("=== Current dist NPCRelationshipSystem ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Fix the import in the compiled dist file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i \"s|from \\\"../territory/TerritoryControl\\\"|from \\\"../guild/TerritoryControl\\\"|g\" /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/modules/npc/NPCRelationshipSystem.js")
print("Fixed import in dist file")
# Verify
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -5 /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/modules/npc/NPCRelationshipSystem.js")
print("\\n=== After fix ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Restart PM2
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart all && sleep 2 && pm2 list")
print("\\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
print("DONE!")
'
